flows.title: Save a search and view its listings
steps: Select Save this search at the top of the search results page. eBay then emails an alert when new items matching the search are listed.
To see the listings later, go to Saved searches — under Saved on the eBay homepage — and choose View items.
To edit a saved search, select it, add or remove filters, then select Save this search. Editing creates a new saved search with the filters you chose.
To delete a saved search, select the blue heart on it.

flows.title: View and tidy your Watchlist
steps: Go to My eBay and select Watching.
Use the Sort dropdown to sort the listings by most relevant, time left, price, seller ID or date added.
Active and ended listings show together by default. Use the dropdown beside Status to see them separately.
To remove items, tick the box beside each one and select Delete. Several can be removed at once.
To add an item from a listing, select Add to Watchlist on the listing, or the heart symbol under an item on a search results page.
